changes: TrackTrack: additional tags can now be created and registered per scope from the REST API, the MCP create_tag tool, and the config-editor task create/edit flow
Added SpriteAnimator primitive: allocation-free frame animator for Pixi sprites with loop/finished semantics and base-texture restore on stop
Exported AnimationClipData type and SpriteAnimator from the engine index for cross-game reuse
Added WebAudio-based AudioService with master/music/sfx gain buses, lazy context creation with user-gesture unlock, and synthesized SFX/music rendered into cached AudioBuffers (no network assets)
Added config-driven SfxDefinition and MusicTrackDefinition types plus noteToFrequency helper; every method is a safe no-op in non-WebAudio environments
Added muted flag to GameSettings for persisted mute state
Added WebAudio-based AudioService with master/music/sfx gain buses, lazy context creation with user-gesture unlock, and synthesized SFX/music rendered into cached AudioBuffers (no network assets)
Added config-driven SfxDefinition and MusicTrackDefinition types plus noteToFrequency helper; every method is a safe no-op in non-WebAudio environments
Added muted flag to GameSettings for persisted mute state
Added optional isElite field to EnemySaveData so elite enemy state survives save/restore
Added addScopeTag service: appends a tag to a scope tag catalog with case-insensitive dedupe, trimming and an EmptyTagError guard
Single-writer hardening: per-key in-process async mutex around every read-modify-write and S3 conditional writes (If-Match) with typed ConflictError on stale ETag
createTaskWithNumber folds task-number allocation into the same locked section as task insert
softDeleteBoard saves board and detaches tasks atomically; session cleanup runs on an interval and after each login
Auth hardening: scrypt-hashed PINs with hash-on-read migration, random bootstrap PIN, per-IP+name login rate limiting, 1MB body cap, generic 500s with request ids
TRACKTRACK_HOST env/--host bind defaulting to 127.0.0.1; MCP stdio line buffering and serialized tool calls
Added Board entity between Scope and Task: nullable Task.boardId, Inbox pseudo-board for tasks without a board
Added boards.ts service: create (order = max+1), update, soft-delete with task detach, task count helper
Extended searchTasks with boards filter incl. none sentinel for Inbox matching
Added boardId to Task zod schemas (create/update/validate) so it survives parse-based validation
Initial headless task tracking core: User, Scope, Task, View, Session types
Zod validation schemas for all domain models
S3-backed atomic JSON storage (read/write/delete/list)
PIN-based auth with session management and 24h expiry
Sequential task numbering per scope with prefix formatting
Scope CRUD with default states/priorities/tags
Fixed spawner infinite loop on failed pool acquire (break instead of continue) and made enemy texture preload failures fatal
Fixed wave-end and teardown pool leaks: scheduled spawns are released to the pool and active enemies fully release (collider unregister, particle recycle, pool return)

Weapon lifetimes moved to game time: AOE throw/detonation and sweep sprite cleanup step on the weapon game-time task list, attack colliders age via accumulated delta, removing all weapon setTimeout/rAF
Explosive splash now rolls through calculateWeaponDamage (owner multiplier + crit) and reports correct damageDealt stats
Persistent ground effects capture enemy position/activeness before takeDamage so kill feedback anchors at the death spot
Save restore validates the payload against a zod schema with numeric clamping and fails gracefully on corrupt saves
Player.addWeapon returns boolean and never silently drops the added weapon

BackgroundTilemap replaced with a single TilingSprite (removes 16k sprites and the per-frame culling loop); enemy particles pooled per texture; swap-remove in spawner; allocation trims in fireWeapons, targeting and projectile stepping
VfxManager honors configured lifetimes/pool sizes; hardcoded gameplay constants moved into globalSettings (combat, steering, spawning, pooling, world, autosave) and weapon schema defaults

Added animation/VFX system (Chunk F): spritesheet atlas pipeline (Pixi v8 JSON), manifest SPRITESHEETS registry, tolerant LoadingScene loading with progress, generated single-frame spritesheets via script for all enemies and player
Added SpriteAnimator to enemies and player: config-driven move/die/idle/run/hurt clips with frameRate/loop, per-enemy animation in enemyCatalogue.json, pool-safe texture restore on release

Added VfxManager with config-driven juice: screen shake (camera-root offset), enemy hit flash (tint lerp), pooled ParticleContainer death particles, boss entrance shake, level-up burst, pickup sparkle, muzzle flash, explosion flash + shockwave ring, sweep trail
Wired weapon VFX events: weaponFired (muzzle flash), explosionVfx (AOE detonation + OnHitPipeline explosion), sweepTrail from SweepWeapon, pickup position for sparkle
Added vfx.json config domain with schema, registry and editor meta; added animation fields to enemyCatalogue schema and meta
All new systems are pooling-first, world-space, event-decoupled and config-driven with no hardcoded values

Added audio config domain (audio.json): 20 synthesized SFX definitions (tone/sweep/noise with envelopes and per-sound throttle), a looping void-theme music track, event-to-SFX wiring and musicByBiome mapping, all editable in the config editor with schema and metadata

Added SfxManager: registers configured sounds into the engine AudioService, plays hit/crit/kill/boss kill/boss spawn sounds, per-kind pickup sounds (gem/heal/coin/chest/vacuum/bomb), level-up jingle, upgrade/evolution sounds, player hurt/death, UI clicks, wave start and victory/game-over stings
Added bossSpawned game event emitted by the spawner for boss spawn audio
Added looping music per biome: game scenes start the configured biome track on entry and stop it on exit; audio suspends on pause and resumes on play
Settings menu now has master/music/sfx volume sliders and a mute toggle, persisted through SaveManager settings and applied live
Audio survives restarts: the AudioService is app-lifetime, buffers are cached, and the context is unlocked on the first user gesture

Added passives config domain: 10 passive items with per-level stat bonuses (multiplier or additive application), max levels and editor metadata; passives appear as level-up cards alongside weapons/stats and level up when re-acquired

Added evolution config domain: 4 recipes (whip+bloodlust, bullet+quickening, grenade+scholar-pact, homing-missile+magnet-heart); the new chest pickup kind triggers evolution when the weapon is at max level and the passive is owned
Added 4 evolved weapons to the catalogue (Bloody Whip, Void Pistol, Doomsday, Swarm Missiles) with distinct boosted scaling

Added luck, xpGain, healthRegen and dodgeChance to the player stat catalog: luck boosts rare card weighting, xpGain scales gem XP, healthRegen ticks HP per second, dodgeChance rolls to negate incoming damage
Added chest, vacuum and bomb pickup kinds wired into default/boss/elite drop tables: vacuum collects all pickups, bomb damages all active enemies
Stat upgrades now use a config-driven application mode (additive vs multiplier); armor no longer special-cased in code
Player weapon and passive slot counts are now config-driven via globalSettings.player
Extracted all shared gameplay logic into BaseGameScene: managers, victory/death flow, enforcer, endless mode, HUD, level-up, save/restore, camera and viewport
GrassLandScene is now a thin biome subclass that only resolves config bundle and tileset from the biome registry; new biomes no longer copy gameplay code
Autosave, restart and attack-mode wiring in main.ts now key off BaseGameScene so future biome scenes work unchanged
Added reaper-style enforcer: config-driven invincible boss that spawns when the final wave timer expires with enemies still alive (globalSettings.enforcerEnabled toggle)
Added biome selection architecture: registry config, select menu with available/coming-soon slots, and scene factory parameterized by biome id
Added endless mode toggle: post-victory wave looping with scaled budget (globalSettings.endlessMode flag)
Tuned maxEnemiesOnScreen performance cap from 150 to 200
Added isActive runtime spawn-state flag to enemies; OnHitPipeline effects and spawner update loop now skip pooled enemies already released this frame
Fixed elite boss chase speed: phase moveSpeedMultiplier now composes with elite speed factor instead of overwriting it
Refactored ranged attack to tickRangedVolley: merged volley config is built only when firing, eliminating per-enemy-per-frame allocation
Simplified cat-boss projectile config: bossBehavior phases now fully control volley params, removing redundant top-level fireIntervalMs/speed/bulletCount/spreadAngleDeg
Added enemy projectile system: pooled world-space shots with EnemyProjectile collision category, armor-mitigated player damage and i-frame protection
Added ranged enemies spitter and hexer (config-driven projectile blocks: fire interval, speed, lifetime, damage, bullet count, spread, fire range) wired into mid/late wave phases
Added cat-boss combat behavior: aimed spread volleys and three enrage phases at HP thresholds (speed, volley interval, bullet count, spread, projectile speed all config-driven)
Added elite enemies: phase eliteChance and explicit-wave isElite flags roll spawns into elites with multiplied health/damage/speed and the guaranteed-rich elite-drops table
Added OnHitPipeline effects driven by damageTypes.json: physical knockback, explosive splash with falloff, bleeding DoT procs with stacking
Added enemyDeathVfx game event as the death-VFX hook point for the upcoming visuals chunk
Defaulted debug toggles (nerdInfo, showCollisionBoxes) to off in globalSettings.json and the Zod schema; they remain config-editor toggles
Retargeted bullet and shotgun weapons to nearest-enemy targeting instead of cursor for survivor-like auto-aim behavior
Added isBoss enemy rule: bosses spawn only via explicitWavesConfig and show a dedicated HUD boss health bar
Added boss-drops drop table (4-6 guaranteed drops weighted toward large XP gems) and wired cat-boss to it
Fixed pnpm typecheck gate: engine @types/node linkage restored, typecheck covers void
Created planning/backlog.md and planning/ARCHITECTURE.md matching implemented reality
Replaced dev GrassBiome values with a real 21-wave, ~17.5-minute run progression (phase unlocks at waves 7 and 14, two difficulty spikes)
Added explicit wave support: final wave spawns cat-boss with a 60-second duration override
Replaced window.location.reload() restart with Director-based scene restart (full manager teardown/re-init)

The TrackTrack container now runs three servers at once: the API server (TRACKTRACK_PORT, 4356), a standalone web GUI server (TRACKTRACK_WEB_PORT, 4357) and an MCP-over-HTTP endpoint (TRACKTRACK_MCP_PORT, 4358), supervised by a new entrypoint that stops the container if any server dies so compose restarts the whole stack
Added server/web-server.ts: serves the built GUI on its own port with a /api/tracktrack proxy (auth, ETag and 1MB body limit passthrough) to the API server, so the GUI works standalone

Added server/http-mcp.ts: stateless MCP JSON-RPC over HTTP reusing the API's /api/tracktrack/mcp handler (Bearer session token or the login tool for auth); TRACKTRACK_WEB=false drops the web server and TRACKTRACK_MCP=false drops the MCP server
Added a task picker to the AI assessment dialog: a checkbox list of every task in the current view with All/None shortcuts and a live count plus token estimate, so any subset of tasks can be assessed
The per-task Assess action in the issue drawer now opens the assessment dialog pre-selected to just that task instead of defaulting to every task in the view
Complete GUI rebuild: original modern interface with List, Board, Planning and Overview views modeled on the config-editor Tasks workflows
Added a robust theming system: dark mode by default, light theme, five vibrant accent colors and a compact density mode, all persisted locally
Added Settings page: appearance (theme/accent/density), admin AI key + default assessment model management (writes the repo-root .env), admin user management with role editing, and account logout
Added saved views: store current filters as named views, apply, update and delete them (server views CRUD now used by the GUI)

Added planning table: sortable columns, inline optimistic planning edits (status, ratings, effect, notes with debounce), shift-range multi-select, select-by-tag and bulk status/state/priority/tag operations
Added kanban drag & drop with optimistic state changes and rollback, plus per-card state dropdown
Added AI assessment UX: single or batch assessment dialog with provider/model override, live job progress with cancel, usage totals and per-task errors
Added assessment query modes: full (default), effects-only (writes just the effect-on-game note) and a custom user query for the model, available in both the built-in GUI and the config-editor
Client now uses ETag conditional requests (If-None-Match) for scopes/boards/views/tasks so repeat loads resolve to 304s; server etag matcher fixed to handle comma-containing combined etags
Keyboard shortcuts: N new task, / search, 1-4 view switching, Esc close, ? help
Login screen redesign: centered card layout with branded header, accent ambient glow and constrained width instead of a full-width form

List view rebuilt as a master-detail layout: the issue list sits on the left while the selected issue opens in a detail pane on the right, the first issue is opened automatically, and an empty list shows a create-issue call to action

Server logs the admin credentials (name / PIN) on every startup; the bootstrap PIN file now lives in TRACKTRACK_DATA_DIR (persistent volume in Docker) and a missing file rotates the admin PIN so logged credentials are always valid
Added POST /api/tracktrack/scopes/:scopeId/tags so signed-in users can register new tags in a scope tag catalog (returns the updated scope, 404 on unknown scope)
Added MCP create_tag tool that registers a tag in a scope and returns the updated scope
Auth model change: random bootstrap PIN written to a gitignored .tracktrack-bootstrap file, scrypt-hashed PIN storage with timing-safe comparison and hash-on-read migration
Login rate limiting (5 failures then 30s backoff), 1MB body cap, self-delete/last-admin guard on DELETE /users
TRACKTRACK_HOST env + --host bind (default 127.0.0.1) with logged bind address; scope-id slug validation
MCP stdio hardening: line buffering across stdin chunks and serialized message processing
Added boards sub-resource REST API: list/create/update/delete with case-insensitive duplicate name 409 and unknown boardId 400 on task writes
Added ?board= repeatable query param (ids + none sentinel) to task list with hasFilter gating
Added MCP tools list_boards/create_board/update_board/delete_board plus board arg on list_tasks and boardId on create_task/update_task
Redesigned task view to Jira-like split layout: task list sidebar + detail panel
Added TaskFormFields reusable component extracted from TaskEditor
Added TaskDetailPanel for inline read/edit task details in list view
Added TaskDetailView for read-only task display with rendered markdown
Added TaskList component for sidebar task cards with selection highlight
Refactored TaskEditor to support defaultMode prop (read/edit)
Kanban view now opens task detail overlay on card click
Added Delete button for admins in read mode
Extracted formatRelativeTime to shared utils
Fixed +New Task button to open the markdown-enabled task editor with empty prefilled fields
Enlarged task editor overlay to fullscreen with split-pane markdown preview
Added markdown toolbar (bold, italic, headings, link, code, lists, blockquote) to task editor
Added edit/split/read mode toggle for the description preview

Web GUI: PIN login, scope selector, task list/kanban toggle, task editor with markdown preview, filters, settings panel for admin user management
Preact + htm + signals UI reusing config editor design system (CSS custom properties, light/dark theme)

TrackTrack tab switched to a dumb HTTP proxy against TRACKTRACK_URL (single-writer: the standalone tracktrack server), removing the duplicated middleware
DOMPurify-sanitized markdown rendering with http/https-only link validation

Save/validation UX: schema errors surfaced in the Inspector with real validation state; stale-closure fixes in domain loading and AI chat

Board filter wired into debounced task reload; selection persisted per scope and restored when valid
Added board dropdown to task forms (defaults to active board) and board badges in task list and detail views

Added FileTreeSidebar component for collapsible folder/file tree views in Assets and Knowledge tabs

Wired task filters (search, state, priority, tag, assignee) to the backend query params
